fields.Name: T144 - MCP Tools Scale Mode Virtual List
fields.Description: Exercises the useScalablePagination virtual-scroll/pagination branch — a completely separate rendering path (native virtual scroll with paged loading) that no other test touches.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Tools tab. Click the 'Scale: OFF' button in the header to enable scale mode (it should change to 'Scale: ON'). Confirm the tools view switches to the scalable/virtualized presentation, which shows a 'Showing X of Y tools' summary above a single scrollable virtual list (instead of the server-grouped card/list layout). Toggle scale mode back OFF and confirm it returns to the grouped view. Seeing the scale-mode toggle change the layout is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A 'Scale: OFF' / 'Scale: ON' toggle button is visible in the Tools tab header
Enabling scale mode shows the 'Showing X of Y tools' summary and a single scrollable virtual list layout distinct from the default grouped view
Toggling scale mode back OFF restores the grouped card/list layout
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
